items.title: Litmus
items.description: A RAG workbench that compares retrieval strategies and checks every citation against the retrieved evidence.
items.stack: Python / FastAPI / React / TypeScript / Qdrant / Docker
items.remaining: What remains: measure dense, hybrid, and reranked retrieval, calibrate the judge against human ratings, and repair the interactive comparison view.
bullets: Built a private document question answering system that runs dense and BM25 retrieval concurrently, fuses results with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and reranks with a cross encoder, with stage level diagnostics and visible degradation instead of silent fallback.
Implemented citation safe generation that treats model output as untrusted: it validates source handles, strips invalid citations, and refuses answers with no valid support.
Designed an evaluation harness that separates deterministic retrieval metrics from schema validated LLM judging, versions the rubric, and records failed examples explicitly.

Added configuration aware regression checks that compare only like for like runs and skip metrics without enough evidence, and enforced tenant and group access scopes inside retrieval and graph traversal.
Measured sparse BM25 retrieval at Recall@5 of 0.945 over 47 questions on my own evaluation set.

items.title: vaak
items.description: A local multilingual voice AI agent that runs entirely on the user's machine, with streaming speech and interruption handling.
items.stack: Python / FastRTC / FastAPI / Ollama / Faster-Whisper / Kokoro
items.remaining: What remains: live end to end latency measurements with real speech, text to speech, and language models running together, spoken language identification from audio, and a decision on native Marathi speech and GPU acceleration.
bullets: Engineered a streaming speech pipeline using punctuation based sentence chunking and token generators to start synthesized audio before the language model finishes, and to halt synthesis when the caller interrupts.
Architected a multi session WebRTC audio handler using prototype cloning and nonblocking semaphores to isolate conversational state per connection and reject excess callers with a busy tone.
Designed conversational memory with a rolling queue and periodic language model summarization, with a deterministic fallback when summarization fails.
Built a dual model transcription stack, Moonshine for English and Faster Whisper for Hindi and other languages, with audio normalization, downmixing, and resampling to 16 kHz.
Containerized the stack with a multi stage Docker build, Bearer token authentication, separate liveness and readiness probes, and a shutdown hook that drains in flight turns for up to 5 seconds.
Measured standalone llama3.2:1b at 62.4 ms time to first token and 38.4 tokens per second.

items.title: TerraQ
items.description: Our team’s CybraneX research project showcases a hybrid quantum-classical solution for lithium and vanadium anomaly detection.
items.stack: NASA EO-1 Hyperion / Python / PennyLane / 6-qubit quantum autoencoder
items.remaining: My role: backend and dataset work.
details: Our team built TerraQ to showcase the solution and problem statement from our CybraneX research: a hybrid quantum-classical pipeline for lithium and vanadium anomaly detection using NASA EO-1 Hyperion hyperspectral data and a 6-qubit quantum autoencoder.
I worked on the backend and datasets.
The pipeline reached an AUC of 0.77 on the NASA dataset and 0.82 on the Sentinel dataset.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: Research, applied engineering, and confidential client work.

items.description: Leading research on DFT in active space embedding with VQE for hybrid HPC quantum molecular simulation. Migrated a Qiskit pipeline to Quantinuum through pytket, resolving operator mapping and qubit ordering incompatibilities. Work spans IBM, Quantinuum, and AWS Braket, with HPC cluster access. Exploring how noise affects VQE results using IBM noise models, the AWS Braket DM1 density matrix simulator, and Quantinuum noise models.

Led a team building a hybrid quantum classical pipeline for lithium and vanadium anomaly detection using NASA EO-1 Hyperion and Sentinel data, including a 6 qubit quantum autoencoder, reaching an AUC of 0.77 on the NASA dataset and 0.82 on the Sentinel dataset. I worked on the backend and datasets.

Evaluated culturally adapted mathematical content for quality, language, cultural relevance, social context, realism, and coherence. Built an academic-paper retrieval pipeline using RAG, ChromaDB, Elasticsearch, and Sentence Transformers. Used Docling and PostgreSQL for document parsing and structured storage, implemented citation graph embeddings, and evaluated hybrid dense and sparse retrieval.

Developed WhatsApp automation with job scheduling and privacy controls for the marketing team, an ML-based symptom classifier, and context-aware email generation. Contributed product features using Python, Flask, MySQL, and JavaScript, with dataset work, testing, and Agile sprint collaboration.
Production websites and two Android apps, deployed under NDA. One is still being scaled.
